title: Cumulative precision loss in rewardPerSecond recalculation
description: The rewardPerSecond calculation involves repeated division operations that cause truncation errors due to Solidity's integer arithmetic. Each time the reward rate is recalculated, small amounts of value are lost to rounding. Over time and with frequent rate updates, these precision losses accumulate and result in a meaningful value leak from the reward pool.
impact: Gradual value leak over time as precision errors compound. The cumulative effect can result in significant underpayment of rewards to stakers, with the lost value becoming permanently trapped in the contract.
attackPath: Each division operation truncates fractional wei
Repeated updates compound the precision loss
Over time, meaningful reward amounts are lost
recommendation: Use higher precision intermediate calculations (multiply before divide). Consider using a precision multiplier (e.g., 1e18) for internal accounting and only converting to actual token amounts at withdrawal time.
